# API reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Solvers

Time-domain and spatial-propagation solvers.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [PropagationSolver](PropagationSolver.qmd#clerq.PropagationSolver) | Solver for the propagation of fields through a medium of systems. |
| [LindbladSolver](LindbladSolver.qmd#clerq.LindbladSolver) | Time-domain master equation solver for a single spatial point. |

## Differentiable propagation

Exact gradients through the propagation (needs the `jax` extra).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [autodiff.AutodiffPropagation](autodiff.AutodiffPropagation.qmd#clerq.autodiff.AutodiffPropagation) | A differentiable version of a :class:`~clerq.PropagationSolver` problem. |
| [autodiff.OptimizeResult](autodiff.OptimizeResult.qmd#clerq.autodiff.OptimizeResult) | The outcome of :meth:`AutodiffPropagation.minimize`. |

## Exceptions

Raised by `PropagationSolver.solve()`.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [exceptions.PropagationInstabilityError](exceptions.PropagationInstabilityError.qmd#clerq.exceptions.PropagationInstabilityError) | Raised when a propagation solve has blown up numerically. |
| [exceptions.CounterPropagatingDepletionError](exceptions.CounterPropagatingDepletionError.qmd#clerq.exceptions.CounterPropagatingDepletionError) | Raised when a counter-propagating field depletes beyond the error threshold. |

## Systems and fields

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [System](System.qmd#clerq.System) | An open quantum system: its states, decays and the fields coupling them. |
| [Field](Field.qmd#clerq.Field) | Field object to address the System object, describing the atomic levels |

## Time functions

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [t_funcs.square](t_funcs.square.qmd#clerq.t_funcs.square) | Return a square (top-hat) pulse time function. |
| [t_funcs.gaussian](t_funcs.gaussian.qmd#clerq.t_funcs.gaussian) | Return a Gaussian pulse time function. |
| [t_funcs.sech](t_funcs.sech.qmd#clerq.t_funcs.sech) | Return a sech pulse time function. |
| [t_funcs.ramp_on](t_funcs.ramp_on.qmd#clerq.t_funcs.ramp_on) | Return a ramp-on time function. |
| [t_funcs.ramp_off](t_funcs.ramp_off.qmd#clerq.t_funcs.ramp_off) | Return a ramp-off time function. |
| [t_funcs.ramp_onoff](t_funcs.ramp_onoff.qmd#clerq.t_funcs.ramp_onoff) | Return a ramp-on / ramp-off time function. |
| [t_funcs.ramp_offon](t_funcs.ramp_offon.qmd#clerq.t_funcs.ramp_offon) | Return a ramp-off / ramp-on time function. |
| [t_funcs.sinc](t_funcs.sinc.qmd#clerq.t_funcs.sinc) | Return a sinc pulse time function. |
| [t_funcs.intp](t_funcs.intp.qmd#clerq.t_funcs.intp) | Return an interpolated time function. |

## Spectral analysis

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [spectral.freq_list](spectral.freq_list.qmd#clerq.spectral.freq_list) | Fourier transform of the tlist into the frequency domain for |
| [spectral.rabi_freq](spectral.rabi_freq.qmd#clerq.spectral.rabi_freq) | Fourier transform of the field result of field index. |
| [spectral.absorption](spectral.absorption.qmd#clerq.spectral.absorption) | Field absorption in the frequency domain. |
| [spectral.dispersion](spectral.dispersion.qmd#clerq.spectral.dispersion) | Field dispersion in the frequency domain. |
| [spectral.susceptibility_two_linear_known](spectral.susceptibility_two_linear_known.qmd#clerq.spectral.susceptibility_two_linear_known) | In the linear regime for a two-level system, the susceptibility is |
| [spectral.absorption_two_linear_known](spectral.absorption_two_linear_known.qmd#clerq.spectral.absorption_two_linear_known) | The field absorption, equal to the imaginary part of the susceptibility. |
| [spectral.dispersion_two_linear_known](spectral.dispersion_two_linear_known.qmd#clerq.spectral.dispersion_two_linear_known) | The field dispersion, equal to the real part of the susceptibility. |
| [spectral.voigt_two_linear_known](spectral.voigt_two_linear_known.qmd#clerq.spectral.voigt_two_linear_known) | Returns the Voigt profile for a two-level system in the linear regime. |

## Hyperfine structure

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [hyperfine.Atom1e](hyperfine.Atom1e.qmd#clerq.hyperfine.Atom1e) | Represents an atom object and contains a list of J levels. |
| [hyperfine.LevelF](hyperfine.LevelF.qmd#clerq.hyperfine.LevelF) | Represents an F hyperfine structure level and holds its magnetic |
| [hyperfine.LevelMF](hyperfine.LevelMF.qmd#clerq.hyperfine.LevelMF) | Represents an m_F hyperfine sublevel. |

## Utilities

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [utility.maxwell_boltzmann](utility.maxwell_boltzmann.qmd#clerq.utility.maxwell_boltzmann) | Maxwell-Boltzmann probability distribution. |
| [utility.half_max_roots](utility.half_max_roots.qmd#clerq.utility.half_max_roots) | Return the half-maximum value and the two roots where ``y`` crosses it. |
